verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API docs show an events retrieval endpoint with sparse fieldsets and cursor pagination (200 events per page). They also describe profile activity tracked as events and promise data can be pulled out headlessly via the public APIs. None of the evidence explicitly shows filtering events by a single profile, or that sent/opened/clicked email engagement events are retrievable per contact. missing for 10: documented per-profile event filtering, explicit sent/opened/clicked metric coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
